global_contract.style: dark funeral fantasy tactical mobile RPG, crisp readable pixel character, muted matte colors, restrained HD-2D compatible lighting
global_contract.canvas: single isolated character only, transparent or plain neutral background
global_contract.do_not: no chibi, no oversized head, no front view, no UI, no labels, no background scenery, no extra characters, no glossy 3D render, no neon
approval_gate: weapon or class prop silhouette readable
not chibi and not oversized head

aim_base.prompt: Create a low aggressive combat crouch state, side view facing east/right, knees bent, torso leaning forward, both hands keeping the weapon or class prop raised and ready. Preserve the exact character identity, palette, outfit, and proportions from the approved base character.

run_base.prompt: Create a fast low combat run state, side view facing east/right, body leaning forward, knees bent, weapon or class prop held ready across the chest. Preserve the exact character identity, palette, outfit, and proportions from the approved base character.

walk.prompt: Run forward in a low combat crouch, weapon or class prop held ready, compact tactical movement, readable foot contacts, no tall upright stride.

aim.prompt: Hold the combat-ready crouched aim pose with subtle breathing sway, stable silhouette, weapon or class prop kept raised.

attack.prompt: Perform the character's battle action from the low combat stance, with a clear anticipation, impact or cast moment, and recovery. Keep the feet grounded and preserve identity.
